cases.message: @default on a prompt field takes one string or one number
prompt "ticketDigestDefault" field "sentences" (int): @default("three") is not an integer -- write one, as in @default("20")
cases.note: What the annotation MEANS: a prompt field's default is a literal of the field's type, as a tool field's is (memql#5430).

cases.message: @default(5) is a number, and the field is a string -- write it quoted, as in @default("5")
cases.note: A prompt field's placement admits an unquoted number, which is a literal of a numeric field only.
